title: Eclectic Mayhem only choice voice of Glowstick Gonzos who hoist moist truths in corduroys to counterpoise noise gathering in wales of failing forward
summary: Eclectic Mayhem only choice voice of Glowstick Gonzos who hoist moist truths in corduroys to counterpoise noise gathering in wales of failing forward hailing on cords of color cascading in stolen stars #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Eclectic Mayhem
  only choice

voice
of
  Glowstick
Gonzos

who hoist
moist
truths
in corduroys
to counterpoise
noise
gathering
in wales
of failing
forward

hailing on
cords
of color
cascading
in stolen stars

#smallpoems
